notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel, adding one mana of any color.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 2.
